description.en: Curses connected to Khaenri’ah’s fall include distinct outcomes associated with ancestry, immortality and transformation. Their mechanics require source-specific treatment. Not all hilichurls originated in the Cataclysm.
description.ru: Проклятия, связанные с падением Каэнри’ах, имеют разные последствия в зависимости от происхождения, бессмертия и превращения. Механизмы требуют разбора конкретных источников. Не все хиличурлы появились во время Катаклизма.

notes.en: Imported from the supplied research pack, not independently checked against game transcripts. Russian labels are editorial translations unless supplied by the pack or already established in this archive; exact official localization and game version require review.
